On clause 5-Chairman chief executive officer.

subtopic: ESTABLISHMENT OF BOARD OF GOVERNORS- CONTINUANCE OF C.B.C.
speechtext:
On clause 5, I return to the question of the chairman, vice-chairman and third member of the board on this executive committee. This clause says:
The board may authorize one or more of its members to act as chairman for the time being in the event that the chairman and vice-chairman are absent or unable to act or the offices are vacant.
Surely it would be normal, and should have been included in the bill, to state that if the chairman or vice-chairman are away the third full-time member of the board would act as the chairman. Under this clause any other members of the board, even a parttime member, could be authorized to be chairman of the board for the time being, overlooking the third full-time member of the board.

subtopic: ESTABLISHMENT OF BOARD OF GOVERNORS- CONTINUANCE OF C.B.C.
speechtext: I think that is true; it could happen. I do not believe it would, but after all this board will know these people. They are sitting on the board and working together, not just today but for months and years. I think it is safe to leave it to the board to designate, in the expectional circumstances which are recognized here, the member who is to act as chairman. They may want to choose somebody else. It may be the third full-time man may be ill or away. This clause does not prohibit him from being chairman. I would think in almost any circumstances which we could reasonably foresee they would be apt to name the third man to act as chairman during the time the others were ill or away.

subtopic: ESTABLISHMENT OF BOARD OF GOVERNORS- CONTINUANCE OF C.B.C.
speechtext: I understand the chairman is to be appointed by order in council, and it would seem this clause would mean that the order in council could only be passed once because you leave it to the board of governors to appoint a chairman after that. Am I correct in my reading of the section that you only appoint a chairman by order in council the first time and after that the board can appoint a chairman if the chairman should pass away?

subtopic: ESTABLISHMENT OF BOARD OF GOVERNORS- CONTINUANCE OF C.B.C.
speechtext: I think the minister had better allow this clause to stand.

subtopic: ESTABLISHMENT OF BOARD OF GOVERNORS- CONTINUANCE OF C.B.C.
speechtext: That is another legal question we will let justice answer.

speakerposition: Deputy Chair of Committees of the Whole
subtopic: ESTABLISHMENT OF BOARD OF GOVERNORS- CONTINUANCE OF C.B.C.
speechtext:
Shall the clause
carry?

subtopic: ESTABLISHMENT OF BOARD OF GOVERNORS- CONTINUANCE OF C.B.C.
speechtext:
No. I do not want to make this observation in any critical sense, but it has been the custom in the past when legislation of this character is being discussed for the minister to be assisted by officers from
Business of the House the Department of Justice to enable him to clear up these points. We are being asked to legislate here and we are not getting answers to questions such as the one just asked by the hon. member for Cartier. It is a proper question and the answer should not be left in an ambiguous state if there is any way of resolving it. It does seem to me the minister could ask that this clause stand until he can get advice on it and make a reply.

subtopic: ESTABLISHMENT OF BOARD OF GOVERNORS- CONTINUANCE OF C.B.C.
speechtext: All of this shows how much better it would have been if we had been able to send this bill to a committee.

subtopic: ESTABLISHMENT OF BOARD OF GOVERNORS- CONTINUANCE OF C.B.C.
speechtext: I thought the hon. member for Cartier was facetious, Mr. Chairman, and I am sure he was. The clause says "for the time being". Of course, you do not need a ruling from justice on that. Under these circumstances the board may authorize one or more of its members to act as chairman for the time being, in the event that the chairman and vice-chairman are absent or unable to act or the offices are vacant.

subtopic: ESTABLISHMENT OF BOARD OF GOVERNORS- CONTINUANCE OF C.B.C.
speechtext:
The minister dealt with subclause 3, but what about subclause 2 which says:
If the chairman is absent or is unable to act or the office is vacant, the vice-chairman has and may exercise all the powers and functions of the chairman.

subtopic: ESTABLISHMENT OF BOARD OF GOVERNORS- CONTINUANCE OF C.B.C.
speechtext: That is a normal provision, I would think, that the vice-chairman acts in the absence of the chairman or in case the office becomes vacant and, for the time being, exercises the duties and responsibilities of the chairman until such time as a chairman would be nominated to succeed him.
